summary: This system helps farmers monitor their land by providing comprehensive predictions and insights. Farmers simply register their details and the location of their land, and in return, they receive a daily report—written in the Egyptian colloquial dialect—outlining the steps they should take to ensure their land reaches its full potential. This process is powered by satellite data and drone imagery, which are transmitted to a server; the server then analyzes this information to generate three potential scenarios, selecting the best one. The system also features an AI model that interacts with the farmer via phone calls, chat, or voice messages, and enables remote management of the land—for instance, by automatically securing the area in the event of storms or heavy rain.
details:
Farmer’s Smart Friend is an AI-powered smart agriculture system designed to support Egyptian farmers and improve agricultural productivity. It connects farmers with advanced technology through a simple mobile application that anyone can use.

Farmers register their information, mark their land boundaries on a digital map, and identify their irrigation source. The system collects real agricultural and weather data from NASA satellites, analyzes it using AI, and generates three possible agricultural scenarios to select the most suitable one. A drone equipped with a camera provides additional images of crops, soil, and irrigation water for more accurate analysis. Within 40 seconds, farmers receive daily reports with simple, practical recommendations.

Our system also includes "Uncle El-Komy," an AI assistant that communicates in Egyptian colloquial Arabic through text, voice messages, and calls. It also provides weather alerts and allows farmers to control protective covers remotely. An interactive dashboard helps agricultural authorities monitor farms and identify farmers who need assistance.

We developed the system using Python, HTML, JavaScript, SQLite, NASA APIs, AI technologies, and ESP32-CAM hardware.

Our creativity lies in combining satellite data, drone imaging, AI decision-making, and natural voice interaction in one integrated platform.

We considered affordability, simplicity, accessibility, data accuracy, and the real needs of Egyptian farmers.

Our ultimate impact is to reduce crop losses, optimize water usage, increase productivity, and support sustainable agriculture in Egypt.
